values.summary: Wait for #310 terminal authority; pin the gate revision; regenerate the complete feature and critical-path denominator; bind each row to exact live, Git, validation, platform, review, and typed evidence; execute forged negatives; retain the pass/blocker packet; obtain one exact-head review.

steps.action: Verify #310 and all named predecessor repository, typed-terminal, review, merge, ancestry, migration, and cleanup identities; pin the gate base and candidate.
Regenerate the complete feature and supporting-critical-path denominator with stable unique row identities.
Resolve every row to exact implementation, review, merge, validation, integration, platform, claim, and terminal evidence.
Execute all prohibited-evidence and cross-repository substitution negatives through the real validator.
Emit matrix, gate record, validation receipt, and blocker report; obtain exact-head independent review and publish only truthful gate status.

invariants: One required row per canonical denominator entry
No self-attested evidence or cross-repository identity substitution
Exact reviewed and merged revisions remain ancestral to the gate candidate
A blocker result cannot unlock downstream work
WP-22 never mutates dependency implementation or lifecycle truth
risks: Migration split leaves ambiguous canonical versus legacy authority
Feature index and supporting critical paths drift during preparation
Retained receipts overstate platform or production-path behavior
Closed issues lack exact reviewed/merge/terminal binding
A validator may accidentally trust internally consistent fabricated JSON
stop_conditions: #310 is not terminal, reconciled, ancestral, and cleaned
Any required denominator entry is missing, duplicate, or ambiguous
Any accepted row lacks independently verified semantic evidence
Repository migration identity cannot be resolved exactly
Fixing a blocker requires product work outside WP-22
